description: Immutable same-candidate final evidence join and HTML report, after all source and manual QA fixes; no rendering or installation

steps.name: immutable-matrix-copy-and-verification-archive
argv: import sys,shutil,zipfile,json;from pathlib import Path;target=Path(sys.argv[1])/'artifacts';source=Path(sys.argv[2])/'artifacts';shutil.copytree(source,target,dirs_exist_ok=True,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('verification-sources.zip'));archive=zipfile.ZipFile(target/'verification-sources.zip','w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED);[archive.write(p,p.as_posix()) for base in ['tests','tools'] for p in Path(base).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p.suffix!='.pyc'];archive.close();old=json.loads((target/'cases.json').read_text('utf-8'));current=json.loads(Path('tests/f014/cases.json').read_text('utf-8'));titles={c['id']:c.get('title') for c in current['cases']};[(c.update(title=titles[c['id']])) for c in old['cases']];assert old==current,'Only presentation titles may change after the matrix';(target/'cases.json').write_text(json.dumps(current,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print('Verified presentation-title-only corrections; execution inputs and all assertions unchanged')
